model: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity (engine route)

inputs.sbc_source: SBC is not XBRL-tagged for SPG. Run-rate ~US$70M/yr from the Q2-2026 supplemental (8-K ex99.1, FFO->FAD reconciliation: Q2-26 $17.7M, Q2-25 $16.5M); H1-26 $75.3M includes a one-off $40.0M accelerated vesting on David Simon's death, excluded from run-rate. Equity-award withholding taxes ~$14M/yr (FY2025 $13.9M, cash-flow statement) added.
inputs.buyback_note: H1-2026 repurchases $336.0M (~1.7M shares); FY2025 $226.8M. Not modelled as accretion -- units held flat, buybacks treated as optionality funded from retained FAD.
inputs.share_count_basis: Common shares 323.560M + Operating Partnership limited-partner units 55.826M = 379.386M at 30-Jun-2026 (Q2-26 supplemental). UPREIT: FFO of the Operating Partnership accrues to common + LP units together, so the divisor includes both. Held flat.
inputs.debt_memo: Engine net_debt is 0 BY DESIGN: the capitalised stream (Real Estate FFO -> AFFO) is after interest, so subtracting debt would deduct it twice. Actual balance sheet for reference: total debt (our share) US$35,731M, consolidated cash US$1,019M at 30-Jun-2026; total debt / total assets 37% vs 65% covenant; Q2-26 secured financings at 5.36% weighted rate. Refinancing drag is carried in the margin path instead.
inputs.fy0_construction: FY2026E Real Estate FFO = guidance midpoint $13.25 x ~380M diluted units = US$5,035M; less straight-line rent ~US$50M (H1-26 $24.9M); less recurring capex (tenant allowances + operational capex, our share) ~US$640M (H1-26 $258.6M, H2 seasonally heavier) = cash AFFO US$4,345M after SBC; less equity-award taxes $14M = US$4,331M ($11.42/unit) house basis. Company FAD-style (SBC added back) = US$4,415M. FY2026E consolidated revenue US$7,220M = H1-26 actual $3,547.7M + H2 estimate (~$3,675M; Taubman consolidated from Q4-25). Engine mapping: 'EBITDA' = cash Real Estate FFO before SBC (70.2% of revenue), cash tax 0 (REIT; entity taxes already inside FFO), capex = recurring capex + SPG-share redevelopment spend, D&A irrelevant at 0% tax.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity, not WACC (post-interest flow). 10y UST ~5.24% (2026-10-01) + 0.9 x 5.0% ERP = ~9.7%, rounded to 9.75% base. Set above O (9.5%) and PSA/MAA (9.0%) because SPG carries ~5.5x net debt/EBITDA, discretionary-retail tenant exposure and a fresh leadership transition. Bull 9.0%, bear 10.75%.
inputs.lease_treatment: SPG is the lessor; ground-lease expense sits inside property operating costs and therefore inside FFO. No separate lease charge.
inputs.nci_treatment: Real Estate FFO is 'our share' -- includes SPG's share of JV and Klepierre (equity-method) FFO and excludes consolidated NCI, so no NCI deduction. Taubman (TRG) consolidated from Q4-2025.
inputs.notes: MODEL: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity via the component engine (routing table row 'REIT / property trust'; same pattern as O, MAA, PSA). Net debt is never subtracted. Stream = Real Estate FFO (company definition: FFO excluding other platform investments -- Catalyst Brands/JCPenney/SPARC-type retail stakes -- and revaluation gains) minus straight-line rent, recurring capex and SBC/withholding. The platform investments are carried at ZERO value (their recent losses are excluded from the stream, their equity value is also excluded -- conservative net). Real Estate FFO per unit: H1-26 $6.46 (+7.5% y/y), Q2-26 $3.29 (+7.9%); FY2026 guide raised to $13.20-$13.30. GAAP EPS/net income are unusable as earnings (FY2025 NI $5,364M includes the Taubman remeasurement gain).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: Real Estate FFO/unit trajectory (FY2026 guide midpoint $13.25, H1-26 +7.5% y/y partly acquisition-driven) net of refinancing drag; book-value and EPS CAGRs rejected
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity (13-21%) and EPS (30-32%) CAGRs diverge >30% from revenue (6.4-6.7%). Both are distorted by the FY2025 Taubman remeasurement gain (NI $5,364M; equity $3,492M -> $6,472M) and by FY2020 COVID base effects. Not usable as growth proxies.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF CAGRs use consolidated reported FCF less estimated SBC (~$55-70M/yr, untagged in XBRL) and equity-award taxes; 5yr starts from the COVID-depressed FY2020 base, 3yr (FY22-25) shows near-flat consolidated FCF. SBC is <2% of FCF so the adjusted and reported CAGRs barely differ.

base.growth_rationale: Organic NOI growth 4-5% (occupancy ~96%, base rent/sf +6.3% y/y, Saks recapture ~$18M -> ~$44M rent) plus the $2B+ redevelopment pipeline, fading to 2.5% by FY2036.
base.margin_rationale: Margin = cash Real Estate FFO before SBC / revenue. Fades ~150bp over five years for refinancing drag: ~$3-4B/yr of maturities rolling from a ~4% book rate to ~5.4% (Q2-26 secured deals at 5.36%) costs ~$45M/yr.
base.capex_rationale: Recurring tenant allowances + operational capex ~8.9% of revenue, plus SPG-share redevelopment (~$0.5B/yr net) through the FY27-29 pipeline, settling at 10% to fund the terminal growth rate.

scenario_narratives.base: Class-A malls and Premium Outlets keep taking share from weaker retail real estate: occupancy holds ~96%, rent spreads stay positive, recaptured Saks/Macy's boxes re-lease at higher rents and the $2B+ mixed-use pipeline delivers. AFFO/unit compounds ~3-4% after refinancing drag, the dividend keeps rising, and Eli Simon's planned succession proves uneventful. Capitalised at a 9.75% cost of equity this is worth less than the current price: the market is pricing a lower discount rate than the house uses.
scenario_narratives.bull: Leasing momentum (new deals +20% y/y, retailer sales/sf +13.9%) persists, redevelopment yields 7-8% on cost, international outlets (Italy, Japan, Korea) add growth, and lower long rates compress the cost of equity to 9%. Real Estate FFO/unit grows 5-6% near term with margins held as NOI growth offsets refinancing.
scenario_narratives.bear: A consumer recession plus tariff pressure on apparel tenants triggers a new wave of retailer and department-store bankruptcies; occupancy slips, percentage rent falls, and maturities refinance at 5.5-6%, compressing post-interest FFO margins by ~400bp. Leadership transition after David Simon's death loses deal-making edge. AFFO flat-to-down for three years, cost of equity 10.75%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Symmetric 25/50/25 rather than the house 15/50/35: leverage ~5.5x net debt/EBITDA makes the post-interest stream sensitive to rates and discretionary retail, and the March-2026 founder-CEO transition is untested; offset by strong current leasing momentum and a raised FY26 guide.

valuation_philosophy.summary: SPG is valued as a REIT: the stream an owner of a common share or OP unit actually receives the economic benefit of is AFFO -- Real Estate FFO less straight-line rent, recurring re-leasing capex, redevelopment spend and SBC -- and because it is already after interest it is capitalised at the cost of equity with no net-debt deduction. GAAP net income (revaluation and remeasurement gains) and consolidated FCF (before JV share and NCI) are not used.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cost of equity is the dominant lever: +/-50bp moves base IV roughly -/+8-9%; the 10y UST print (~5.24%) drives it.
Refinancing drag: $35.7B of our-share debt rolling to ~5.4% from a lower book rate compresses post-interest FFO margins; the base case assumes ~150bp over five years.
Anchor/department-store attrition (Macy's closures through 2028, Saks/Exemplar) and tenant bankruptcies in a consumer downturn.
Redevelopment execution and capital intensity: the capex path assumes ~$0.5B/yr SPG-share development through FY29; overruns or slow lease-up reduce AFFO conversion.
Other platform investments (retailer stakes) carried at zero -- an upside optionality not in the value, but their losses are also excluded from the stream.
Leadership transition after the death of David Simon (March 2026).

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 172.19-238.50
data_sources.financials: SEC XBRL (SPG_Metrics.csv / core_metrics) for revenue, FCF and balance-sheet history; Q2-2026 earnings 8-K ex99.1 supplemental (filed 2026-08-10, accession 0001104659-26-093361) for Real Estate FFO, FFO->FAD reconciliation (tenant allowances, operational capex, straight-line, SBC), unit counts and total debt (our share).
